decisions.why: Round 2's list is now carried in full: the precinct bullet with its area, crown count and canopy share re-measured, the well, arches and torii lines, the approach kind and the program's approach rule are each named (programs.md line 85 already reads 'the precinct's edge'). But D6 scopes the restatement to a named list, and the list still leaves out texts on this sheet that D4 itself makes false, with no argument - FR-007 requires the sheet's notes and its kinds' write-ups updated to the new form. D4 opens 'the ground behind the hall (the well and its path)', yet: (1) the footpath kind (interactive/compound_kinds/shrine.py, Footpath: What 'A worn footpath through the grove from the building's kitchen side to the well', Why '... runs where they go - through the grove'), drawn on this sheet as data-kind="footpath"; (2) the notes' swept-clearing bullet (hoshigaoka-shrine.notes.md line 17) 'a footpath runs from its north-west corner ... through the grove to the well'; (3) the svg comments at the path (line 60, 'footpath to the well through the grove') and the grove group (line 64, 'the whole precinct but the clearing, the approach and the path'), and the header comment (line 11, 'the shrine's well at the grove's back'), which the round-2 D6 named ('header comment') and this list no longer does. And under two flanks the clearing is not ringed by wood: (4) the swept clearing kind (shrine.py SweptClearing: What 'bare earth kept clear inside the grove', Why 'the grove left standing round it', Covers 'inside the grove'). (5) For consistency with the notes' sacred-tree bullet D6 already names, the sacred tree kind's 'the grove's greatest tree' (shrine.py line 162) is restated the same way. Required: D6 names items 1-5 and restates them to the sides form (or form-neutrally for the shared kinds, as the approach kind is). A grep of the sheet directory and compound_kinds/shrine.py for 'grove' finds no other stale text: notes lines 11, 27 and 39 remain true under sides.
